critique.evidence: Across desktop, tablet, and mobile, automated checks report no confirmed WCAG violations, no touch-target violations, and no viewport overflow. One pulse explicitly uses motion-reduce:animate-none. However, color contrast remains seriously unresolved for 83/83/78 live-wire nodes because gradient backgrounds prevented measurement, including headings, body copy, table labels, metadata, and status text. No measured keyboard-only operation, focus-order, focus-visibility, or activation results were provided, and reduced-motion coverage is proven only for one animation.
critique.fix: Resolve contrast against actual rendered gradient states, adjusting colors or using solid backplates until every text and UI state meets WCAG AA. Add measured keyboard tests for complete Tab/Shift+Tab order, visible focus, row/control activation, and absence of traps at all three viewports. Audit every animation and transition under prefers-reduced-motion, not only the replay pulse.
